retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist beach scene featuring disembodied mannequin parts partially buried in sand, framed by a thick red border with outlined sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast surrealist photograph of a beach where a mannequin's face and hand emerge from the sand like archaeological finds. The scene is enclosed in a vibrant red frame with white-outlined red text positioned at the top and vertically along the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Mannequin face in the foreground buried in sand
Mannequin hand floating/emerging in the upper left midground
Ocean waves and horizon line in the background
Thick solid red border framing the entire image
Outlined typography overlapping the top of the image
coreInvariants: Mannequin parts must have a plastic, non-human texture
Vibrant red lipstick and nail polish on the mannequin
Primary red border and matching text outline color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large mannequin face in the bottom foreground; smaller hand in the upper left; secondary face buried in the midground right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The mannequin face with bright red lips in the lower center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large face in the foreground, up to the floating hand, then across the horizon line to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sandy beach and ocean provide textured negative space between the plastic subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sand beige and ocean blue (natural background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (border, lips, nails, text outline)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against the muted, natural tones of the beach.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rendered as outlines only, allowing the background to show through the centers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two distinct weights and orientations (outline vs solid).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and clean circular forms.
Classic geometric sans-serif that supports clean outline treatments.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 80s-style photograph of a beach. In the foreground, a plastic mannequin face with red lips is half-buried in the sand. In the upper left, a mannequin hand with red nails emerges from the air/sand. Surround the image with a thick, solid red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top. The text should be an outline only in the same red as the border. Add vertical white text inside the left red border.

verificationChecks: Is the main text an outline only?
Is there a thick red border around the image?
Are the mannequin parts textured like plastic rather than skin?
Is the side text oriented vertically?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact brand logos
Ensure mannequin features are stylized and not hyper-realistic
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red of the border matches the red of the text outline.
Ensure the mannequin's face is partially submerged in sand texture.
Verify the horizon line is straight and level.
Confirm the typography is legible despite the outline treatment.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Object + Natural Environment + Thick Primary Border + Outlined Geometric Type
